CHANGELOG updated in BIG_O: feat(day/client): the IDUNA app -- real device-auth flow on the phone (BP_APP_IDUNA), closes §25 item 2. First real HTTP call from inside the live client gameplay loop, reusing the existing async NetJob mechanism. Found and root-caused a real IDUNA bug along the way (device-auth polling never worked against SQLite) -- fixed in IDUNA, not yet deployed. bazel test //... 41/41 green, real live scratch harness against the actual IDUNA server. (sess-20260923-1030-4a526255)

⚓ ☃
